name: Past Death Regression
source:
I thought unpacking would be the worst part. I didn't expect classmates whispering behind my back – or people dying. Now they think I'm a killer.

Maybe Mom should've questioned that generous job offer.

[From [url=https://spikycaterpillar.itch.io/past-death-regression]Itch.io[/url]]
